map.按承载能力极限状态基本组合计算组合效应设计值。: Design value of the combined effect under the basic combination of the ultimate limit state.
map.永久荷载分项系数 γ_G: Partial factor for dead load γ_G
map.可变荷载分项系数 γ_Q: Partial factor for variable load γ_Q
map.γ_G 通常 1.2~1.3，γ_Q 通常 1.4~1.5: γ_G is usually 1.2 to 1.3 and γ_Q usually 1.4 to 1.5
map.有多个可变荷载时取效应最大的为主导: With several variable loads, take the one with the largest effect as the leading load
map.📚 深度解析：荷载基本组合计算（土木）: 📚 In-depth analysis: basic load combination calculation (civil)
map.框架梁柱设计：取 1.2D+1.4L（+1.4×0.6W 或 +1.3E）等组合: Frame beam and column design: take combinations such as 1.2D+1.4L (plus 1.4 × 0.6W or 1.3E) and detail the steel for the most adverse internal force.
map.对比恒载控制与活载控制：哪个组合起决定作用随 D/L 比值变化。: Compare dead-load-controlled and live-load-controlled cases: which combination governs shifts with the D/L ratio.
map.风与地震不同时参与：二者取不利者，不叠加，避免内力高估。: Wind and seismic do not act together: take the more adverse of the two instead of superposing them, which would overestimate internal forces.
map.梁端 D=50kN·m、L=80kN·m：组合 M=1.2D+1.4L=1.2×: For a beam end with D = 50 kN·m and L = 80 kN·m: the combined M = 1.2D + 1.4L = 1.2 × 50 + 1.4 × 80 = 60 + 112 = 172 kN·m. If wind participates, take 1.2D + 1.4L + 1.4 × 0.6W, adding another 16.8 kN·m when W = 20.
map.0.6 和 0.9 系数什么意思？: What do the 0.6 and 0.9 factors mean?
map.风/地震的频遇与准永久效应的组合值系数（如 0.6W），表示该荷载在组合中打折参: They are combination values for frequent and quasi-permanent effects of wind or seismic action (such as 0.6W), meaning the load is discounted in the combination because it does not reach its full value at the same time as the live load.
map.哪个组合一定最大？: Is one combination always the largest?
map.不一定。小活载大恒载时恒控组合更大；应把所有规定组合都算一遍取包络，不能只看一种: Not necessarily. With small live load and large dead load the dead-load-controlled combination is larger. Compute every prescribed combination and take the envelope rather than looking at just one.
map.正常使用组合用什么系数？: Which factors apply to the serviceability combination?
map.标准组合（分项系数=1）看变形与裂缝，基本组合（1.2/1.4）看承载力，两者用: The characteristic combination (partial factors = 1) governs deformation and cracking, while the basic combination (1.2/1.4) governs capacity. They serve different purposes, so do not mix them.
